text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан's weakness is her
competitive spirit.
She relentlessly
battles each opponent that
challenges
her, burning up her stamina and

throwing off her natural pace.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I suggest a new racing style—don't react
to any
challenge, hold back the building
urge to
compete, and finally, let loose in
an explosion of
speed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Using this new strategy, Нарита Брайан
wins her next
scrimmage. On top of that,
she isn't exhausted
afterward—rather,
she's brimming with energy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
